# Alcuin

> A CLI and stdio MCP server that sends a question and chosen source files to ChatGPT,
> or to the OpenAI or Azure OpenAI API, and saves each answer as a durable session.
> Windows and Linux only; model labels in ChatGPT do not prove which backend model answered.

Version 0.1.0. Release archives carry both binaries for Linux (x86_64, glibc 2.39 or later)
and Windows (x86_64), and `alcuin.mcpb` installs the MCP server in Claude Desktop. To build
instead, use Rust 1.99 or later: `cargo install --locked --path .` in a checkout. Browser runs
need a Chromium-based browser: Alcuin looks for Chrome and Edge on Windows, and for Chrome,
Chromium, Brave and Edge on Linux; to use another, such as Brave on Windows, set `CHROME_PATH`
to its executable.
